name: SJ Corporation Limited
about: SJ Corporation Limited engages in the manufacturing and selling of diamond-studded jewelry in India. The company operates through two segments, Diamond Studded Jewellery and Polished Diamonds & Real Estate and Development of Property. It also trades in polished diamonds. In addition, it is involved in the real estate development business. The company was formerly known as Corcomp Infosystems Limited and changed its name to SJ Corporation Limited in October 2007. SJ Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.
